summary: Confirm booking can no-op when ResponseEntity.exception is ignored after createBooking.
bug_statement: Tapping Confirm does nothing after selecting stylist and time slot.

hypotheses.claim: createBooking failure path does not surface error to the UI

likely_root_cause.explanation: Async confirm path likely drops ResponseEntity.exception instead of emitting an error ScreenState.

reproduction_steps: Open a salon service booking screen
Select stylist, day, and available slot
Tap Confirm booking and observe missing feedback
recommended_fix: After createBooking, branch on response.exception and emit submitError / ScreenState.error; show it in the UI.

findings.explanation: Booking confirm ignores API exception, so the user sees no failure.
findings.recommendation: Emit submitError from ResponseEntity.exception and map it in BookingScreen.
